v.1: Sing to Yahweh a new song! Sing to Yahweh, all the earth.
v.2: Sing to Yahweh! Bless his name! Proclaim his salvation from day to day!
v.3: Declare his glory among the nations, His marvelous works among all the peoples.
v.4: For great is Yahweh, and greatly to be praised! He is to be feared above all gods.
v.5: For all the gods of the peoples are idols, But Yahweh made the heavens.
v.6: Honor and majesty are before him. Strength and beauty are in his sanctuary.
v.7: Ascribe to Yahweh, you families of nations, Ascribe to Yahweh glory and strength.
v.8: Ascribe to Yahweh the glory due to his name. Bring an offering, and come into his courts.
v.9: Worship Yahweh in holy array. Tremble before him, all the earth.
v.10: Say among the nations, "Yahweh reigns." The world is also established. It can't be moved. He will judge the peoples with equity.
v.11: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice. Let the sea roar, and it's fullness!
v.12: Let the field and all that is in it exult! Then all the trees of the woods shall sing for joy
v.13: Before Yahweh; for he comes, For he comes to judge the earth. He will judge the world with righteousness, The peoples with his truth.
